meta.name: hook-setup
meta.description: Inspect and install CCAM monitoring hooks for Claude Code and Codex. Use when onboarding a provider, repairing missing hooks, checking which provider is active, or validating that installation preserved unrelated user hooks.

copy.tagline: 检查并安装 Claude Code 与 Codex 的监控钩子
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要为 Claude Code 或 Codex 安装或修复监控钩子。
copy.tagline_en: Inspect and install monitoring hooks for Claude Code and Codex
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Claude Code or Codex and need to set up or fix their monitoring hooks.

howto.what: Claude 会先运行 `ccam hooks status` 检查 CCAM 监控钩子的状态，报告哪些 provider 的钩子缺失或将被替换；经你确认后执行安装，再复核状态并启动真实会话验证事件能到达 CCAM。安装只替换 CCAM 自有的钩子，不碰你其他的钩子。
howto.when: 当你要接入新 provider、修复缺失的 hooks、查看当前激活的是哪个 provider 等场景时触发。

say.text: 检查一下当前 CCAM hooks 状态。
say.note: 会运行 ccam hooks status 并显示结果。

say.text: 验证安装后无关 hooks 是否保留。

howto.what_en: Claude will run `ccam hooks status`, report missing or replaceable provider hooks, install them after confirmation, then verify a real session reaches CCAM. Only CCAM-owned entries are replaced; unrelated hooks are preserved.
howto.when_en: When onboarding a provider, repairing missing hooks, checking active provider, or validating that unrelated user hooks are preserved.

say_en.text: Verify unrelated hooks remain after install.
